title: Reinstated Hold Term Calculation — Homesite Reservation
content:
**Clause.** The reinstated hold term of a Homesite Reservation is the reinstated base length plus the lapse days added back plus the reinstatement loyalty bonus, less the reinstatement card shortening and less the reinstatement letter shortening, all in whole calendar days, with no rounding. The term is counted from the reinstatement date.

The reinstated base length is the class's extension days. Nothing is added back for the days the hold stood lapsed. The reinstatement loyalty bonus, the reinstatement card shortening and the reinstatement letter shortening are each zero days. The reinstated hold term is therefore the class's extension days, counted from the reinstatement date, with nothing added back for the days the hold stood lapsed.

## Composition

| Element | Value | Direction |
|---|---|---|
| Reinstated base length | the class's extension days | added |
| Lapse days added back | none | added |
| Reinstatement loyalty bonus | zero days | added |
| Reinstatement card shortening | zero days | subtracted |
| Reinstatement letter shortening | zero days | subtracted |

The term has no cap and no rounding.

## Worked example (hypothetical class extension days of 6)

A hold that expired on 11 August and is reinstated on 13 August: 6 plus nothing plus zero, less zero and less zero, is 6 days. The hold expiry date written is 13 August plus 6 days, which is 19 August; the two lapsed days are not added back.
